meta.title: distinctUI+ with the big plugins
meta.author: distinctui
meta.description: Installs the theme and distinctUI+ from this branch, with WooCommerce, Yoast SEO, Contact Form 7, WP Super Cache and the MCP Adapter and the MCP Adapter, then runs tests/playground/dui-test.php.

steps.data:
<?php
// Playground test only: keep the last 30 distinctUI+ REST calls (method, route, body size, section count, status) for dui-test.php?log.
if ( ! defined( 'DUI_PLUS_PLAYGROUND_TEST' ) ) { return; }
add_filter( 'rest_request_after_callbacks', function ( $res, $handler, $req ) {
	if ( 0 !== strpos( $req->get_route(), '/distinctui-plus/v1' ) ) { return $res; }
	$spec = $req->get_param( 'spec' );
	$log  = (array) get_option( 'dui_test_log', array() );
	$data = is_wp_error( $res ) ? $res->get_error_message() : ( $res instanceof WP_REST_Response ? $res->get_data() : $res );
	$log[] = $req->get_method() . ' ' . $req->get_route() . ' ct=' . $req->get_content_type()['value'] . ' body=' . strlen( (string) $req->get_body() ) . ' json=' . ( is_array( $req->get_json_params() ) ? 'yes' : 'no' ) . ' spec.sections=' . ( is_array( $spec ) ? count( (array) ( $spec['sections'] ?? array() ) ) : gettype( $spec ) ) . ' out.sections=' . ( is_array( $data ) && isset( $data['spec']['sections'] ) ? count( $data['spec']['sections'] ) : '-' ) . ' head=' . substr( (string) $req->get_body(), 0, 80 );
	update_option( 'dui_test_log', array_slice( $log, -30 ), false );
	return $res;
}, 10, 3 );
